z-m-12-11.title: Sanduuqa daboolan ma A mise B?
z-m-12-11.goal: Mar kasta oo tirada kubbadaha la soo saaray kordho, dib u eeg xukunkaaga iyo kalsoonidaada ku saabsan haddii sanduuqu yahay A mise B, oo sharax in marka natiijooyinku si fiican ugu habboonaan waayaan midna sanduuq, aad ku shakiyi karto malo-awaalkaaga bilowga.

z-m-12-07.title: 1 m² waa imisa cm²?
z-m-12-07.topic: Xiriirka u dhexeeya cutubyada bedka m² iyo cm²
z-m-12-07.goal: Fahan sababta xiriirka cutubyada dhererka (1 m = 100 cm) aan si fudud loogu gudbin karin cutubyada bedka, samee dhowr laba-gees-dherer oo leh bed 1 m² adigoo isticmaalaya cm, kadibna sharax si walaal yar u fahmi karo.
z-m-12-07.material: Fasalka Jiho wuxuu rabaa inuu sameeyo gees akhris oo leh bed si sax ah 1 m² dhinac ka mid ah fasalka. Jiho ayaa yidhi, "1 m waa 100 cm, sidaas darteed 1 m² waa 100 cm²." Walaalkiis yar Harin, oo Fasalka 3 ah, ayaa maqlay tan oo jahwareertay. Cutubyada dhererku waa cm iyo m, cutubyada bedka-na waa cm² iyo m². (cm² waxaa loo akhriyaa "sentimitir labajibbaaran," m²-na waxaa loo akhriyaa "mitir labajibbaaran.")
z-m-12-07.thinking.0: Helista khaladka u gudbinta xiriirka dhererka si toos ah bedka
z-m-12-07.thinking.1: Samaynta dhowr laba-gees-dherer oo buuxiya shuruudaha
z-m-12-07.prereq.0: Helista bedka laba-gees-dherer iyo labajibbaaro (heerka Fasalka 4)
z-m-12-07.prereq.1: Xiriirka u dhexeeya cutubyada dhererka cm iyo m

z-m-12-07.s.s1.prompt: Jiho wuxuu sidan u xalliyey isagoo maanka ku sawiraya labajibbaaro dhinacyadiisu yihiin 1 m. Dooro hal khad oo khaldan.
z-m-12-07.s.s1.hint.0: Calaamadee khad kasta sida kuwa ku saabsan "dherer" ama "bed".
z-m-12-07.s.s1.hint.1: Si toos ah u hel bedka labajibbaaro dhinaceedu yahay 100 cm cm oo la barbar dhig gunaanadka xalka.
z-m-12-07.s.s1.line.0: Ka fikir meel qaabkeedu yahay labajibbaaro oo dhinacyadiisu yihiin 1 m.
z-m-12-07.s.s1.line.2: Bedka labajibbaaro waa (dhinac)×(dhinac), sidaas darteed 1 m × 1 m = 1 m².
z-m-12-07.s.s1.line.3: 1 m waa 100 cm, sidaas darteed 1 m² waa 100 cm².
z-m-12-07.s.s1.explain: Khadka 4 waa khalad. Dherer ahaan, 1 m = 100 cm, laakiin bed ahaan, 100 cm × 100 cm = 10000 cm². 100 cm² waa bedka labajibbaaro dhinacyadiisu yihiin 10 cm oo keliya.
z-m-12-07.s.s2.prompt: Waxaad rabtaa inaad gees akhriska ka dhigto laba-gees-dherer leh bed si sax ah 1 m². Go'aami ballaca iyo dhererka cm oo geli. Ballaca iyo dhererku labaduba waa tirooyin dhan laga bilaabo 40 cm ilaa 250 cm, ballaca iyo dhererka la beddelay-na waxaa loo tiriyaa isla qaab, sidaas darteed hal mar oo keliya tiri. Hel 3 qaab oo kala duwan.
z-m-12-07.s.s2.hint.0: Dooro ballac, oo ka fikir, adigoo u beddelaya m, waxa dhererku waajib u yahay si ballac × dherer uu u noqdo 1 m².
z-m-12-07.s.s2.hint.1: Lammaanaha aad heshay, qor wax-ku-dhufashada ballaca iyo dhererka oo hubi dhammaantood inay isku mid yihiin.
z-m-12-07.s.s2.fail.c1: Fadlan ballaca iyo dhererka geli sida tirooyin dabiici ah.
z-m-12-07.s.s2.ok.c2: Waa ugu yaraan 40 cm ugu badnaan 250 cm.
z-m-12-07.s.s2.fail.c2: Ballaca iyo dhererku waa inay noqdaan ugu yaraan 40 cm ugu badnaan 250 cm.
z-m-12-07.s.s2.fail.c3: Bedku maaha 1 m². U beddel ballaca iyo dhererka m oo ku dhufo.
z-m-12-07.s.s2.explain: Haddii bedku yahay 1 m², waa 10000 cm². 100×100, 50×200, 80×125, iyo 40×250 dhammaantood waxay buuxiyaan shuruudaha (kala beddelidda ballaca iyo dhererka waa isku qaab). Kuwani waa lammaanayaal halka wax-soo-saarka ballaca iyo dhererka uu yahay 10000.
z-m-12-07.s.s3.prompt: U sharax Harin si fudud sababta 1 m² ay tahay 10000 cm², ma aha 100 cm². Harin waxay taqaanaa dhufasho iyo shabakadaha cm, laakiin cutubyada bedku waa wax cusub oo ay u yihiin. Waa fiican tahay inaad u qorto sida adigoo sawir erayo ku sawiraya.
z-m-12-07.s.s3.hint.0: Isku day inaad ku bilowdo adigoo sheegaya waxa Harin horeyba u taqaan (dhufasho, labajibbaarayaasha 1 cm).
z-m-12-07.s.s3.hint.1: Sawir buuxinta labajibbaare dhinacyadiisu yihiin 1 m oo lagu buuxiyo labajibbaarayaal 1 cm ah, oo tiri imisa labajibbaare ayaa saf keliya ku jira iyo imisa saf ayaa jira.

Waxaa jira 100 labajibbaare dhinaca dhinaca iyo 100 saf oo sidaas oo kale ah hoos u socda. Sidaas darteed waxaa jira 100×100=10000 labajibbaare, 1 m²-na waa 10000 cm².

z-m-12-02.topic: Samaynta jajabyo cabbir isku mid ah iyo mabda'a yaraynta jajabyada

U yeedh hal labajibbaaro dhexe iyo labajibbaarooyinka kore, hoose, bidix, iyo midig ee dhexe, 5 labajibbaaro wadar ahaan, "iskutallaab." Haddii dhexe yahay 15da, iskutallaabtu waxay kooxayn tahay 8, 14, 15, 16, 22. Dhammaan 5-ta labajibbaaro ee iskutallaab waa inay noqdaan labajibbaarooyin taariikheed oo kalandarkan ah, labajibbaaro ku sii socda safka xiga kadib dhammaadka safka-na ma aha deris. z-m-12-06.material: Kuwani waa xeerarka tartanka jiidista xadhigga. Koox lumisa hal mar waa baxdaa, sinnaan-na ma jirto. Laba koox ayaa ciyaar kasta ciyaara. Koox lammaane la'aan ah ayaa u gudubta wareegga xiga iyadoon ciyaarin (bye), bye-na lagu tirin maayo sida ciyaar. Tartanku wuxuu dhammaadaa marka hal koox oo horyaal ah ay hadho. Dugsiyada qaar ayaa qabta ciyaarta kaalinta 3aad-4aad qaarna ma qabtaan, haddii dugsi qabto, ciyaartaas waxay ka mid tahay tirada ciyaaraha. Leh 2 koox waxaa jira 1 ciyaar, leh 4 koox-na waxaa jira 3 ciyaarood (2 semifinal, 1 finaal). Doyun ayaa yidhi, "Haddii tirada kooxuhu laban-laabmaan, tirada ciyaaruhuna sidoo kale way laban-laabmaan."

z-m-12-10.prereq.1: Midabka kubbado badan leh waa mid u badan in la soo saaro
z-m-12-10.s.s1.prompt: Samee 3 naqshad sanduuq oo kala duwan oo shuruudaha ku habboon. Geli tirada kubbadaha casaanka, buluugga, iyo huruudka.
z-m-12-10.s.s1.hint.0: Marka aad doorato tirada kubbadaha huruudka ah, tirada kubbadaha casaanka ah waa go'an. Isku day imisa kubbadood oo huruud ah ayaa ka dhigi kara wadarta inay ku dhacdo xadka.
z-m-12-10.s.s1.hint.1: Ka dib doorashada tirada casaanka iyo huruudka, hubi xadka lambarrada kubbadaha buluugga ah noqon karaan, labadaas lambar dhexdooda, oo waafaq wadarta.
z-m-12-10.s.s1.ok.c1: Saddexda midab mid kasta waa tiro dabiici ah oo ugu yaraan 1.
z-m-12-10.s.s1.fail.c1: Fadlan geli tiro dabiici ah oo ugu yaraan 1 saddexda midab dhammaantood.
z-m-12-10.s.s1.ok.c2: Kubbadaha casaanka ah waa 3 jeer kubbadaha huruudka ah.
z-m-12-10.s.s1.fail.c2: Tirada kubbadaha casaanka ah ma aha 3 jeer tirada kubbadaha huruudka ah.
z-m-12-10.s.s1.ok.c3: Kubbadaha buluugga ah waa ugu yaraan kuwa huruudka ah oo ka yar kuwa casaanka ah.
z-m-12-10.s.s1.fail.c3: Tirada kubbadaha buluugga ah waa inay noqotaa ugu yaraan tirada kubbadaha huruudka ah oo ka yar tirada kubbadaha casaanka ah.
z-m-12-10.s.s1.ok.c4: Waxaa jira ugu yaraan 10 iyo ugu badnaan 24 kubbadood oo wadar ah.
z-m-12-10.s.s1.fail.c4: Wadarta tirada kubbadaha ma u dhexayso 10 iyo 24. Beddel tirada kubbadaha huruudka ah oo eeg wadarta.
z-m-12-10.s.s1.explain: Haysashada 2, 3, ama 4 kubbadood oo huruud ah waa suurtagal. Tusaale ahaan, (casaan, buluug, huruud) = (6, 2, 2) wadartiisu waa 10, 6=3×2, 2≥2, 2<6. (6, 5, 2), (9, 4, 3), iyo (12, 6, 4) sidoo kale way shaqeeyaan. Haddii ay jirto 1 huruud, wadartu waxay ka gaabtaa 10, haddii ay jiraan 5 ama ka badan, waxay ka dhaaftaa 24.
z-m-12-10.s.s2.prompt: Mina wuxuu sameeyay sanduuq leh 6 casaan, 2 buluug, iyo 2 kubbadood oo huruud ah wuxuuna soo saaray 10 jeer, wuxuuna helay casaan 5 jeer, huruud 3 jeer, buluug-na 2 jeer. Maadaama casaanka uusan ahayn 3 jeer huruudka, Mina wuxuu u maleynayaa naqshaddu way khaldanayd. Waa maxay habka ugu fiican ee loo eego?
z-m-12-10.s.s2.hint.0: Natiijooyinka 10-ka soo saarid ku dhig lambarrada sanduuqa (6, 2, 2) ku jira oo sheeg waxa isku mid ah iyo waxa kala duwan.
z-m-12-10.s.s2.hint.1: Ka fikir haddii 10 jeer mar kale laga soo saaro isla sanduuqa ay bixin lahayd isla natiijo sax ah, oo is barbar dhig natiijooyinka labada wareeg.
z-m-12-10.s.s2.o.a: Naqshaddu waa khalad. Haddii ay jiraan 6, 2, 2 kubbadood, tirada jeerarka la soo saaray sidoo kale waa inay noqotaa 6, 2, 2.
z-m-12-10.s.s2.r.a: Waxaad u maleysay in saamiga tirada kubbadaha uu u muuqdo si sax ah, sida uu yahay, tirada jeerarka la soo saaray.
z-m-12-10.s.s2.o.b: Naqshaddu waa sax. Maadaama huruuddu yar soo baxday, huruuddu way u badan tahay inay soo baxdo marka xigta.
z-m-12-10.s.s2.r.b: Haddii aad kubbadaha dib u celiso oo isku qasto, natiijooyinka hore ma beddelaan suurtagalnimada xigta, laakiin waxaad u maleysay inay beddelaan.
z-m-12-10.s.s2.o.c: 10 soo saarid waa tiro yar, sidaas darteed way khaldami kartaa. Kordhi tirada soo saarista, samee marar badan, oo is barbar dhig.
z-m-12-10.s.s2.r.c: Tani waa fikradda arkaysa in natiijooyinka tirada yar ee isku dayada ay kal ku ruxmi karaan, oo isku dayaysa inay hubiso adigoo kordhinaya tirada isku dayada.
z-m-12-10.s.s2.o.d: Casaanku wuxuu soo baxay inta ugu badan, sidaas darteed waa la caddeeyay in naqshaddu sax tahay.
z-m-12-10.s.s2.r.d: Waxaad xaqiijisay in naqshaddu sax tahay natiijada hal tijaabo.
z-m-12-10.s.s2.explain: Suurtagalnimada casaanka ee ah 3 jeer tan huruudka macnaheedu waa fursadda in la soo saaro waa 3 jeer, ma aha inuu si sax ah u soo baxo 3 jeer inta badan (6 jeer iyo 2 jeer) 10 soo saarid dhexdooda. Isku day yar, kal ayaa ku khaldami kara, marka aad sii badiso mar kasta waxay guud ahaan sii dhowaataa saamiga tirooyinka. Casaan 5 jeer iyo huruud 3 jeer waa natiijo si fiican u dhici karta.
